title: Dexacraft SMP
description: A forever world for people to hangout and avoid our real life responsibilities.
body:
Are you old? Do you have a life outside of video games? Do you have a dream build that would take years to complete but nowhere to put it? Then Dexacraft wants you!

Dexacraft is a 21+ SMP forever world for people to hangout and escape from their real world responsibilities. Our world is 3 years old and as a forever world we have no intentions of resetting. It is "vanilla-like" with some quality of life additions like Vanilla Tweaks, custom models and textures. We are a friendly and chill community and are accepting of all kinds of people.

Applications for whitelist are done through our discord server https://discord.gg/pV8QVQwx
